text:
maya_ahmed: Quick heads-up — our Q3 reservations forecast jumped after the Acme onboarding trial. Overnight telemetry showed a sustained 4.2x increase in seq-length-tail tokens for embeddings workloads.

sam_wu: Oof. Is that concentrated on a single region/cluster?

maya_ahmed: Mostly us-west1 playground and dedicated-dp-01. Raj, can you confirm whether the traffic is routed to Dedicated or falls back to Hosted?

raj_khatri: Checked logs — 85% routed to dedicated-dp-01, fallback to hosted only for spikes > 90th percentile. Autoscaler kept up but we hit soft concurrency limits twice at 03:12 and 03:46.

lina_fin: TL;DR: this will push the forecasted reserved GPU hours for Aug by ~18%. Need approval to move $120k from the experimentation buffer to reserved commitments or we risk higher spot/hosted delta cost.

sam_wu: Can we mitigate by temporarily increasing batching or enabling prefix caching for the Acme job? Any perf risk?

raj_khatri: We can enable aggressive prefix KV caching for that customer (config: `cache.policy=aggressive`, TTL=12h). Should drop token compute by ~22% on their steady-state. No model change required.

maya_ahmed: Good short-term. Lina — with that mitigation, what delta remains on the reservation ask?

lina_fin: With 22% savings, forecast bump reduces to ~10% increase. That's still ~65k additional commitment. Option A: shift $65k from Q3 experiments. Option B: short-term spot coverage and revisit at mid-Q3 when we have usage post-onboarding.

sam_wu: If we pick Option B, we need an alert & runbook so finance doesn't get surprised. Also need tagging so spend attributes to Acme customer. Current tags are messy: `team=acme-onboard` exists but not on some ephemeral pools.

raj_khatri: Agreed — I'll push a tagging sweep script: `./tools/tag-sweep --owner acme --enforce` and a guardrail that refuses to spin new ephem pools without `billing_project` tag. Can have that deployed in ~24h. Devops-bot: deploy scheduled?

devops-bot: @raj_khatri scheduled deploy to prod fleet at 12:30 UTC tomorrow. Rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-rollback on >1% error rate.

lina_fin: OK — here's my proposal: enable caching now (Raj), deploy tagging guardrail (Raj), finance to cover spot delta for 30 days (Option B) while we collect two weeks of post-change telemetry, then revisit reservation commit. I need a written sign-off from Eng and Ops by EOD today to reassign $65k from experimentation if the telemetry still shows uplift.

maya_ahmed: I sign off on the plan. Will monitor telemetry and ping if we see regressions.

sam_wu: I sign off too. Also requesting an automated daily snapshot of GPU hours by customer (`/reports/gpu-hours-by-customer`) to be emailed to #finance at 08:00 UTC.

lina_fin: Thanks — I'll log the provisional spot coverage in the budget sheet and mark the $65k as pending. If after 14 days the daily report shows sustained uplift, finance will move to commit reserves and notify legal for contract amendment.

maya_ahmed: Appreciate it.

sam_wu: :thumbsup:
